subject: Says delivered but no package
body: Tracking says my order was delivered yesterday at 2:14pm but there is nothing at my door. I checked with my neighbors and the leasing office too. It was a $140 pair of boots, so I'd like to get this sorted.

subject: Wrong size, want to exchange
body: I bought the Cairn rain shell in a medium and it's too tight in the shoulders. It's unworn with the tags still on. Can I swap it for a large? No rush.

subject: Charge I don't recognize!!
body: There's a $64.20 charge from Northwind Outfitters on my card and I haven't ordered anything from you in over a year. I'm worried someone got hold of my card number. I've already frozen the card, so what do I do about this charge?

subject: Promo field freezes on mobile
body: On my iPhone the promo code box freezes the whole checkout page as soon as I tap it. Tried Safari and Chrome, same result. I can order from my laptop, but I thought you'd want to know.

subject: Order incomplete and something dented
body: My order NW-50911 showed up today but the headlamp is missing from the box, so I only got two of the three items. Also the lid on the cook pot is dented, though it's usable. Mainly I need the headlamp, since that's why I ordered everything together.

subject: Rude staff at the Asheville gear swap
body: I went to your pop-up at the Asheville gear swap on Saturday and the guy at the returns table was dismissive when I asked about a warranty claim. He actually rolled his eyes. I've been a customer for years and expected better.

subject: Box arrived crushed
body: FYI the box my camp stove came in was completely flattened on one corner, like someone drove over it. The stove works fine and I don't need anything replaced. Just thought you'd want to pass this along to the carrier.

subject: Return label never came
body: I started a return for my headlamp on your portal Monday and was told a prepaid label would be emailed. Nothing yet, and I've checked spam. Could you resend it?

subject: Please delete my account
body: I'd like my account and saved payment info deleted. I don't plan on shopping with you again. Please confirm by email once it's done.

subject: Sponsorship request
body: I'm organizing a charity trail run in Asheville this April and we're looking for gear donations or a small sponsorship for raffle prizes. Who would I talk to about that?

subject: Where is my refund?
body: I mailed back the Pathfinder boots on the 2nd and the tracking says you received them on the 9th. It's now the 30th and there's still no refund on my card. Can someone look into this?

subject: Thank you!
body: Just wanted to say thanks to whoever helped me last week with my tent swap. It was fast and painless, and I'm heading out on my trip tomorrow because of it. Keep up the good work.

subject: Logged out AGAIN
body: Fantastic, your site logged me out for the fifth time while I was typing my card number. Truly a premium shopping experience. Can someone fix whatever is causing this?

subject: wheres my order
body: ordered 2 weeks ago still nothing?? no email no tracking nothing. order number is NW 51190. pls help

subject: Size guide link is dead
body: The size chart PDF on the Pathfinder boots page gives me a 404. I'm between a 10 and a 10.5 and really need that chart before I order.

subject: Return window question
body: I bought a pair of trekking poles 35 days ago and never opened them because the trip got cancelled. I know the window is 30 days. Is there any chance you'd take them back anyway?

subject: Love the surprise shipping fee
body: Oh great, 'free shipping on orders over $75' and my order was $82.40, yet I still got hit with $12.95 for shipping. Fantastic. Please fix this or explain how your math works.

subject: Need paddle by Saturday
body: I ordered a canoe paddle with standard shipping and the estimate now says Monday, but my river trip is this Saturday morning. Is there any way to upgrade to overnight or at least get it out of the warehouse faster? I'll pay the difference.

subject: Charged twice for order NW-51876
body: Hi there, my bank statement shows two identical charges of $289.00 for the Ridgeline tent I ordered on Tuesday. Only one order confirmation came through. Could you reverse the duplicate? Thanks, Dana

subject: Need bigger jacket before Thursday
body: The Summit jacket I ordered fits too snug over my layers, and I'm hiking in the White Mountains this coming Wednesday. Can I exchange it for an XL and have the new one overnighted? I'll cover the shipping.

subject: Locked out, need to order today
body: My account says it's locked after too many login attempts and the unlock link has expired. I need to place an order today because my guide trip leaves tomorrow morning and I still need a stove. Can you unlock it, or place the order for me?

subject: Will this tent fit two adults and a dog?
body: Thinking about the Ridgeline 2-person. My husband and I are both tall and we have a 60 lb lab who sleeps with us. Would you say it's realistic, or should I size up?

subject: Someone changed my address
body: I got an email saying the shipping address on my account was changed to somewhere in Tampa. I did not do that and I don't live there. I'm worried someone is in my account, and I have an order pending.

subject: App crashes on launch
body: Since yesterday's update the Northwind Trails app closes right after the logo shows. I've restarted my phone and reinstalled it twice. I'm heading out tonight and need it to download offline maps.

subject: GPS watch won't pair
body: My new Quartz GPS watch will not pair with my phone, it just spins on 'searching' forever. I've tried a reset per the manual. If this can't be fixed I guess I'll just send it back.

subject: Promo code didn't apply
body: I used the SPRING15 code at checkout and it said 'applied', but my total never changed. I already placed the order (NW-50342). I'd like the 15% taken off, please, since I was counting on that discount.

subject: Missing points on rewards
body: My Trailhead Rewards balance didn't go up after order NW-49002, which should have earned me about 280 points. Last time I bought something it worked fine. Can you add them?

subject: Zipper failed on sleeping bag
body: The main zipper on my Drift sleeping bag came apart after only two nights of use. I'd like a replacement rather than a refund, if you have the 20F in regular length. I leave for a trip on Saturday, so I need to know quickly.

subject: Need an invoice for taxes
body: Hello, I bought a stove and two fuel canisters for my guiding business last month. Can you send a proper invoice with our business name (Redfern Trail Guides) on it? It's just for bookkeeping, no hurry.

subject: Tracking hasn't moved
body: Ordered a Cascade 45L pack on the 3rd and tracking has said 'in transit' since the 6th with no new scans. Is it lost somewhere? Order # is NW-48213.

subject: Order problem
body: Hi. My order is wrong and I need it fixed. I've been waiting a while and nobody has gotten back to me. Please call me.

subject: Do you ship to Canada?
body: Hi! I live near Calgary and have been eyeing the Summit down jacket. Do you ship to Canada, and roughly what would shipping and duties cost? Thanks.

subject: Checkout error 502, sale ends tonight
body: I've tried to buy the clearance Drift sleeping bag five times in the last half hour and keep getting a 502 error at the payment step. The sale ends at midnight tonight and I don't want to lose the price. Is your payment page down?

subject: Gift card balance is wrong
body: I used a $100 gift card on order NW-49730 but the receipt only took $60 off, and the card now shows a $0 balance. Where did the other $40 go? I paid the difference with my credit card assuming it was right.

subject: Change delivery address ASAP
body: I just placed order NW-52210 about twenty minutes ago and realized it's going to my old apartment. I'm leaving town Friday, so it has to reach my new address (14 Alder Court, Boise) before then. Please update it before it ships!

subject: Tent poles snapped, safety issue
body: Two pole segments on my Ridgeline tent snapped in a mild gust on our first night out. A splinter nearly hit my kid's face and we had to pack up and leave at 1am. I want a full refund, and I think someone needs to look at this batch.

subject: Wholesale pricing for our guide company
body: I run a small guiding company in Montana and we outfit about 30 clients a season. Do you offer wholesale or group pricing on packs and sleeping bags? Happy to chat by phone if that's easier.

subject: Password reset email not coming
body: I've requested a password reset four times and nothing shows up in my inbox or spam. My email is the same one I use for orders. Please help me get back in.

subject: Sent the wrong color
body: I ordered the Alpenglow headlamp in forest green and got the orange one. Not a big deal, but I'd prefer the green. How do I swap it?

subject: Update my email address
body: I changed jobs and my old work email is going away. Can you change the email on my account to the one I'm writing from? Thanks.
